seo.title: Hydrate — Simple Water Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track your daily water intake with a beautiful progress ring. Quick tap logging, widgets, Apple Watch support. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SIMPLE WATER TRACKER
hero.title: Track your daily water intake.
text: Log your hydration in seconds with quick tap presets. A beautiful progress ring keeps you motivated all day.

items.title: Quick Tap Logging
items.text: Pick a preset size — 8oz, 12oz, 16oz, or 20oz — and tap. Done. Custom amounts for any container. Satisfying haptic feedback with every log.

items.title: Beautiful Progress Ring
items.text: Watch your daily progress fill up in a gorgeous animated ring. Hit your goal and celebrate with a delightful animation. Centered design keeps you focused.

items.title: Smart Reminders
items.text: Gentle nudges to keep you on track throughout the day. Customize timing and frequency to match your schedule. Never forget to drink water again.

items.title: Home & Lock Screen Widgets
items.text: See your progress at a glance without opening the app. Multiple sizes for Home Screen and Lock Screen. Your hydration status, always visible.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Log water directly from your wrist. Complications show your progress on any watch face. Quick-add buttons make tracking fast and effortless.

items.title: Streak Tracking
items.text: Track your consecutive days of hitting your goal. Build momentum and stay motivated. Your longest streak is saved forever.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your data stays yours.
text: Zero data collection. Zero tracking. Zero cloud storage. Your water intake is stored only on your device. Optionally sync to Apple Health — you control when and if this happens.

cta.title: Start hydrating.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
